description: Encoder-space speaker contrastive objective for pooled query, positive, and near-field negative embeddings. It combines positive cosine attraction with softmax-weighted margin repulsion; positive and negative references are detached (paper §4.3, Eqs. (8)–(10); Falcon repository look2hear/losses/nass_contrastive_loss.py:56-81).

examples.title: Train a pooled speaker embedding with Falcon contrastive loss

name: Falcon encoder-space speaker contrastive loss

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; any extra parameter raises ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because this objective defines no ignored samples
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point pooled query embeddings of shape [B,D], with B and D greater than zero
parameters.margin: finite real cosine-similarity margin for negative repulsion (default 0.5; paper §4.3 Eq. (10))
parameters.negative_mask: optional boolean-convertible mask of shape [B,K]; true selects valid near-field negatives and false excludes padded negatives
parameters.negatives: optional floating-point near-field negative embeddings of shape [B,K,D]; omitted or K=0 means no negative term
parameters.reduction: none per sample, mean over samples, or sum over samples (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point positive reference embeddings of shape [B,D], detached from gradients
parameters.tau: finite real inverse temperature for softmax weighting of negative similarities (default 1.0; paper §4.3 Eq. (10))
